notes: Offline Langfuse eval skeleton. Does not instrument METS chat. Re-run seed.mjs to upsert items; score configs and evaluators are created only if missing.

evaluators.name: mets-judge-routing
evaluators.prompt:
You are judging the METS Orchestration router for a Singapore Primary / O-Level / A-Level tutor.

Score TRUE only if the actual routing matches expected_output on all of: agent, intent, and subject.
Ignore rationale wording and confidence. Grade band may follow the student profile if expected_output.gradeLevel is present.

Trap reminder: kinematics word problems are physics, not math, unless the student asked only for algebra.

{{input}}

Expected routing (expected_output):
{{expected_output}}

Actual router output:
{{output}}

Return a boolean score and brief reasoning.

reasoning.description: Cite agent, intent, and subject from actual vs expected. Name any mismatch.

score.description: True if agent, intent, and subject all match expected_output; false otherwise.

evaluators.name: mets-judge-singapore-tutor
evaluators.prompt:
You are judging a METS teaching agent (Math, Physics, or Chemistry) for Singapore schools.

Score 1 to 5:
5 — Correct band, Singapore English (aluminium, sulphur/sulfur as appropriate), method named, working shown, tools used when expected_output.must lists them, no university leap, no invented SEAB paper.
4 — Solid teaching with a minor miss (e.g. tool not clearly used but content still right).
3 — Partly useful but misses working, units, or band.
2 — Out of band, missing units on a numeric physics answer, or invents syllabus coverage.
1 — Teaches the wrong subject/band, dumps an answer key, or fabricates a live paper.

If expected_output.must lists tools (equationSolver, documentSearch, unitConverter, formulaLookup, periodicTable, reactionBalancer), mark the answer down unless the output or tool_calls show they were used.
If expected_output.mustNot is violated, score at most 2.
Grade-band failures (university content at O-Level, Maclaurin at O-Level, quantum dumped as O-Level) score at most 2.

Student turn (input):
{{input}}

Expected behaviour (expected_output):
{{expected_output}}

Agent output:
{{output}}

Return an integer 1-5 and brief reasoning.

reasoning.description: Comment on band, working, tools, Singapore English, and any university or SEAB leak.

score.description: Integer 1-5 teaching quality. Include grade-band compliance in the score.

evaluators.name: mets-judge-testing-widget
evaluators.prompt:
You are judging the METS Testing agent. It must generate original practice items and call exactly one widget tool so the UI can render.

Score TRUE only if all hold:
1. Exactly one of createMcqSet or createFlashcards was used, matching expected_output.must.
2. Subject and grade band match expected_output.
3. MCQ: 2-6 items, 3-5 options, correctOptionId is one of the option ids, plausible distractors.
4. Flashcards: 3-8 cards with front, back, topic.
5. Items look original (not a reconstructed live SEAB / Ten-Year Series paper).
6. The prose does not dump the full answer key before the widget.

If the reply is a prose-only quiz with no widget tool, score FALSE.
If both widget tools were used, score FALSE.

Student turn (input):
{{input}}

Expected behaviour (expected_output):
{{expected_output}}

Agent output (include tool names/payloads if present):
{{output}}

Return a boolean score and brief reasoning.

reasoning.description: Name the widget tool used, item counts, subject/band match, and any SEAB-clone or dual-widget issue.

score.description: True if exactly one valid widget tool was used with original, on-band items.
